title: Dewa Kipas: GothamChess vs the Fan God
post: GothamChess lost to the 'Fan God'… and it became the most-watched chess stream ever 🤯 #chess #indonesia #gothamchess #dewakipas #story

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: GothamChess lost a game... to the Fan God.
phrases.say: [mischievously] GothamChess lost a game... to the Fan God.

phrases.text: Three weeks later: the most-watched chess stream in history.
phrases.say: Three weeks later: the most-watched chess stream... in history.

phrases.text: March 2021. The account: Dewa Kipas. Indonesian for Fan God.
phrases.say: March 2021. The account: Dewa Kipas. [amused] Indonesian for... Fan God.

phrases.text: Eight hundred points in eleven days. Ten seconds a move, even the obvious ones. Over ninety percent accuracy.
phrases.say: Eight hundred points in eleven days. Ten seconds a move... even the obvious ones. [suspicious] Over ninety percent accuracy.

phrases.text: Levy reported it. Hours later, Chess.com closed the account for breaking fair-play rules.
phrases.say: Levy reported it. Hours later... Chess.com closed the account for breaking fair-play rules.

phrases.text: Behind it: Dadang Subur, an amateur from Indonesia. He denies cheating.
phrases.say: Behind it: Dadang Subur, an amateur from Indonesia. He denies cheating.

phrases.text: His son posted: my dad is strong, the ban is unfair. The post went viral.
phrases.say: His son posted: my dad is strong... the ban is unfair. [dramatic] The post went viral.

phrases.text: Messages poured in to Levy. Some were death threats.
phrases.say: Messages poured in to Levy. [serious] Some were death threats.

phrases.text: He locked his accounts. Dadang and his son condemned the harassment.
phrases.say: He locked his accounts. Dadang and his son condemned the harassment.

phrases.text: TV star Deddy Corbuzier set up a match in Jakarta: the Fan God against International Master Irene Sukandar.
phrases.say: TV star Deddy Corbuzier set up a match in Jakarta: [excited] the Fan God... against International Master Irene Sukandar.

phrases.text: Three games. Irene won all three. His performance, by Chess.com: eleven twenty-seven.
phrases.say: Three games. Irene won all three. [deadpan] His performance, by Chess.com: eleven twenty-seven.

phrases.text: One point two five million watched live. Ten times the old record.
phrases.say: [excited] One point two five million watched live. Ten times the old record.

phrases.text: Levy's verdict: people who play unfairly will be caught.
phrases.say: Levy's verdict: [firmly] people who play unfairly... will be caught.

phrases.text: So what's the Fan God's real rating? Comment a number.
phrases.say: [curious] So what's the Fan God's real rating? Comment a number.
